scientific.integrity: The motivating conjecture and stronger open problem were materially inspected in the primary archive-era sources. The closest later full-text treatment was checked and does not cover the claim. The proof's finite algebraic components are independently replayed by the packaged exact checker.
limitations: Only ordinary nesting after recentering is proved; preservation of strong nesting remains unresolved.
No quantitative boundary-separation estimate is obtained.
The finite-dimensional proof uses a dimension-dependent vector-rounding argument.

source_ids: Banach Center Publications 84 (2009), Open Problem Session, Problem 2
title: Centering preserves nesting in continuous symmetric chains
